title: obione intermedia
intro: Obione intermedia, commonly known as Sea Purslane, is a succulent plant species native to the coastal regions of Europe and North Africa. Sea Purslane has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of inflammation, skin issues, and digestive problems. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the skin and gut. The bioactive constituents of Sea Purslane include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
